decision: Can one train-only monotone affine-logistic mapping of the frozen unclipped L2 h16 full score repair proper-score calibration on reused L2d episodes while preserving the independently confirmed full-versus-state signal and its support/lifecycle boundaries?

evaluation.use: single post-selection evaluation on already observed L2d episodes; may select fresh confirmation but is not independent evidence

gate.nonbaseline_support: known-nonbaseline rows occur in all eight episodes, meet positive support, and have negative calibrated-full minus state-only point Brier
gate.prefirst_hit_lifecycle: pre-first-HIT rows occur in all eight episodes, meet positive support, and have negative calibrated-full minus state-only point Brier
gate.proper_score_repair: complete-episode bootstrap upper endpoint for calibrated minus uncalibrated full Brier is below zero
gate.signal_preservation: complete-episode bootstrap upper endpoint for calibrated full minus state-only Brier is below zero

hypotheses.H1_probability_link: If L2d failed only because an unclipped linear score was converted to probability by clipping, a two-parameter train-only affine-logistic map will have a complete-episode bootstrap upper endpoint below zero for calibrated minus uncalibrated full Brier.
hypotheses.H2_signal_preservation: The monotone mapping preserves the confirmed representation: calibrated full remains better than state-only under the frozen h16 complete-episode bootstrap and at least six of eight episode directions.
hypotheses.H3_boundaries: Known-nonbaseline and pre-first-HIT point deltas remain negative with the unchanged L2d support minima and all eight episodes represented.
hypotheses.H4_calibration: Absolute calibration-in-the-large is at most 0.002 and calibrated ECE exceeds state-only by at most 0.001, exactly reusing the L2d readiness limits.
hypotheses.H5_selection_limit: L2d has already been inspected. Passing can select this fixed two-parameter surface for a future fresh confirmation only; it cannot independently confirm, promote, or authorize value learning.

non_goals: no new Wine episode, corpus mutation, feature, target, horizon, base ridge fit, action ranking, history, MLP, object encoder, RL, IQL, OPE, critic, or actor
no temperature, isotonic, beta, spline, binning, regularization, optimizer, or threshold sweep
no diagnostic propensity, baseline identity, lifecycle, stage, boss, spell, ECL, RNG, run identity, source, or future fact as a model input
no counterfactual successor, causal action-effect claim, HIT-reduction claim, NMNB claim, or online execution
no claim of independent confirmation from the already observed L2d episodes
